description: Branch component the breaker is attached to, must be "Line" or "Transformer".
Name of the line or transformer the breaker is attached to. At most one active breaker per branch.
Fixed status of the breaker (1 closed, 0 open). An open breaker takes its branch out of power flow and optimisation in that snapshot. Ignored in optimisation if `switchable=True`.
Switch to let the optimisation decide the status in each snapshot (binary variables, optimal transmission switching).
Status before the first optimised snapshot, used for the switching costs of a switchable breaker.
Cost per switching operation (opening or closing) of a switchable breaker.
Maximum voltage angle difference across an open breaker. Bounds the big-M relaxation of Kirchhoff's voltage law for the open branch, so it must not cut off realistic angle differences.
Switch to let the optimisation decide whether to install a switchable breaker (binary variable). A branch can only be opened if the breaker is installed.
Fixed period costs of installing the breaker (e.g. annuitized investment costs). Only used if `extendable=True`.
Whether to consider the component or not
Status of the breaker (1 closed, 0 open) in the optimisation.
Whether the breaker is installed (1) or not (0) in the optimisation. Only optimised if `extendable=True`.
Whether the breaker switched in the snapshot (1 is yes, 0 is no). Only returned if `switchable=True`.
Voltage angle difference across the open breaker, net of the phase shift of a transformer, in the optimisation.
